correctness.rationale: Exact index-two rectangular geometry; convergent two-coset energy identity; Poisson and Jacobi product establish Hessian formulas. A strict monotonicity proof for x/sinh(cx) yields lambda_A/A^2 > lambda_B/B^2, hence factor 3. Large and small Gaussian scales are derived from rigorously exponentially converging direct/dual expansions. Finite positive mixtures add positive gaps. A standalone checker passes 49 independent real-space/dual-series comparisons. The infinite theorem rests on the proof, not finite tests.

value.rationale: Relative translation of the two index-two sublattices is a canonical smallest-period optical perturbation of the triangular crystal. The two polarization curvatures define intrinsic stability diagnostics not determined by global minimality. Their optimal scale-independent ratio 3 and exponential broad-Gaussian splitting distinguish distinct energy scales and supply a reproducible nontrivial benchmark for quantitative periodic crystallization. The result intentionally does not claim the complete phonon spectrum.
